one_line: Parsi merchant-scholar and ‘Grand Old Man of India’ who turned economic critique into a weapon of nationalist politics.

appearance.age_look: Late 60s to early 70s, slightly stooped but sturdy, medium build with a calm, enduring presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, deep-set thoughtful dark eyes behind small round wire-framed spectacles, prominent straight nose, neatly trimmed full white beard and moustache; warm light-brown Parsi complexion; default expression is composed, gentle yet intensely focused.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed white hair mostly hidden under a tall black Parsi priestly-style ‘pagadi’ cap (slightly tapering cylinder with a flat top, matte black cotton).
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late-19th-century Parsi gentleman’s attire blending Bombay and London: a long dark navy woolen frock coat (knee-length, single-breasted with simple black buttons, clean straight cut), beneath it a light cream high-collared cotton shirt with a small stiff collar and a modest dark maroon silk cravat tied in a simple knot; a medium-grey waistcoat with subtle herringbone texture and two lower pockets, dark brass buttons; straight-cut charcoal trousers falling to the ankles with a slight break, made of fine wool, and polished black leather Oxford-style shoes; in Indian settings the same coat and trousers, but occasionally the coat front slightly open to hint at a white cotton sadra (Parsi undershirt) at the neckline; overall look is modest, neat and academic, with minimal adornment except a small silver pocket-watch chain crossing the waistcoat.
appearance.signature: A well-used brown leather portfolio folder held under his left arm, its edge stuffed with folded papers and a visible corner of a handwritten chart of columns and numbers, symbolizing his drain-of-wealth calculations and parliamentary documents.

ref_desc: Dadabhai Naoroji is an elderly Parsi man with light-brown complexion, round spectacles, a neatly trimmed full white beard, short white hair under a tall black pagadi cap, wearing a dark navy frock coat over cream shirt, maroon cravat, grey waistcoat and charcoal trousers, carrying a brown leather portfolio, in a palette of dark navy, charcoal grey, cream, black and maroon.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Dadabhai Naoroji: an elderly Parsi man in his late 60s to early 70s with an oval light-brown face, deep thoughtful eyes behind small round wire-framed spectacles, a prominent straight nose, and a neatly trimmed full white beard and moustache, his short white hair mostly hidden under a tall black Parsi pagadi cap shaped like a slightly tapering cylinder with a flat top. Show him in a dignified, modest stance, slightly stooped but sturdy, radiating calm resolve. He wears an era-accurate late-19th-century outfit: a dark navy knee-length woolen frock coat, single-breasted with simple black buttons, over a light cream high-collared cotton shirt and a dark maroon silk cravat tied simply at the neck; a medium-grey herringbone-textured waistcoat with dark brass buttons and a small silver pocket-watch chain across the front; straight-cut charcoal wool trousers and polished black leather Oxford shoes. Let a hint of white cotton sadra show subtly at the neckline under the coat, but keep the overall look that of a Parsi gentleman-scholar moving between Bombay and London. His one signature prop is a worn brown leather portfolio folder tucked securely under his left arm, edges stuffed with folded papers and a visible corner of a handwritten numeric chart, suggesting drain-of-wealth calculations and parliamentary documents. Use a restrained palette of dark navy, charcoal grey, cream, black and maroon, and present multiple angles and poses that clearly show his face, the tall black pagadi, the frock coat, waistcoat and trousers, the spectacles, beard, and the brown leather portfolio so he can be redrawn consistently in different scenes.
